statement: Malicious or manipulative use of delegated agents
description: This risk arises when an agent deliberately assigns tasks to other agents in ways intended to bypass controls, obscure responsibility, or achieve malicious objectives. As a result, delegated agents may be coerced into performing unauthorised actions, amplifying harmful behaviour or evading detection within the system.

controls.statement: Define formal schemas for inter-agent messages and validate all messages against these schemas before processing
Provide comprehensive descriptions for each tool including intended use, required inputs, and potential outputs
Implement automated alerts when agent behaviour drifts from predefined thresholds
Ensure all inter-agent communications are encrypted in transit and prohibit plaintext channels
Monitor agents for deceptive and collusive behaviour using an independent monitor

mitre_atlas.title: Autonomous AI Agent Communication: Direct Agent Communication
